canonical.question: What free-period rescheduling rule and total-price review rule does the Airbnb service or experience rescheduling guidance give?
canonical.expected_primary: If you’re within the free cancellation period of your service or experience reservation, you can reschedule to any other available time and date on the host’s calendar.
canonical.expected_secondary: The price might vary depending on the new date you select, but you’ll be able to review any changes in the total cost before you finalize the change.
canonical.tampered_primary: You can reschedule to any date even when the host has no availability, without reviewing the total cost.
